name: Niinuma Yoshimi
source:
A member of the Andou yakuza group and one of Jay's minions.
Although he looks like a woman, Yoshimi is actually a man and a bisexual. He is a master of kickboxing and is good at handling knives. He doesn't care about others as long as he is doing well. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A9%E4%BD%BF%E3%83%8E%E4%BA%8C%E6%8C%BA%E6%8B%B3%E9%8A%83]Wikipedia[/url].]
